products.name: Surfer SEO
products.note: SEO optimization AI; content scoring; NLP analysis; EU-hosted options

profile_text.body:
Surfer is an SEO and AI visibility platform founded in 2017 and headquartered in Wrocław, Poland. The company describes itself as built for marketing and SEO teams, and its site positions it as a tool for tracking and improving brand visibility across Google and AI search engines including ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity. Its stated approach centers on analyzing content structure, depth, and credibility as signals that influence both traditional search rankings and citations by large language models.

The company's primary product, Surfer SEO, is categorized as a writing and editing tool with capabilities that include content scoring, NLP analysis, AI-assisted writing, keyword research, topical authority planning, and competitive analysis. The site also references a suite of adjacent utilities including a Chrome extension, an AI search volatility tracker, an AI detector, and an AI humanizer. One user quoted on the site reports having more than doubled blog content production while decreasing the cost to produce SEO content by more than 4x. EU-hosted options are noted for the product.

No litigation, SEC filings, MCP server registrations, or patent records are present in the held facts for Surfer.
